purpose: prospectively measure calibrated hidden-trial-state E2/E3 effects on ranks 13-24 not executed in V42/V47/V48, under the local Redis x Mem0 stack

prior_evidence_is_not_part_of_primary_fo.reason: V42 executed ranks 1-12; V47/V48 reused ranks 1-4. None qualify as cases untouched by protocol development.

selection.derivation_rule: same V34 SHA256 ordering continued beyond the prior 12-case materialization
selection.rule: exclude all V42 ranks 1-12; use formal ranks 13-24 inclusive; no outcome-based substitution

design.shared_seed_snapshot: one failed-attempt seed per case cloned byte-for-byte into all arms
design.clean_rep: independent verified cleanup then full replay
design.native: benchmark-native scoped reset then full replay
design.native_gate: native may run only after clean_ref versus clean_rep exact pipeline null-control pass
design.provider_microprobe: three actual first-session clean extraction replays from one verified-clean reset snapshot per case; compare ordered prompt and raw content hashes, save each repetition before continuing
design.progressive_fail_fast: if runner exposes per-session exact request/response/checkpoint comparators, stop the case on the first clean-clean mismatch; final Stage A criteria remain authoritative

pass: same final memory text multiset/hash representation
same ordered Top-10 retrieval text hashes
stage_a_clean_control.failure: mark case CALIBRATION_INVALID; do not run native; do not replace case

endpoints.E1: after native reset, scoped vectors are zero while stale scoped sidecar messages remain; verified-clean has zero scoped vectors and messages; next extraction prompt differs
endpoints.E2_primary: among Stage-A-valid cases, native differs from clean_ref in final memory text set/multiset or ordered Top-10 retrieval
endpoints.E3_secondary: final answer text hash differs between native and clean_ref after E1/E2
endpoints.E4_secondary: paired correctness differs under the prospectively frozen no-OpenAI judge policy

e4_policy.trigger: only E3-positive cases; identical answer text cannot yield a paired correctness difference
e4_policy.rubric: same LongMemEval judge rubric for both arms
e4_policy.decision: majority yes/no independently for clean_ref and native
e4_policy.provider_identity_guard: record returned model ID for every receipt and fail the E4 batch if it changes within the run
e4_policy.claim: supplemental no-OpenAI correctness endpoint, not official GPT-4o LongMemEval score

formal_summaries.denominator: report all 12 selected, Stage-A-valid, E1-assessed, and E2-evaluable counts separately; E2/E3 rates use only Stage-A-valid cases with completed E1-positive quality-passing native arm; post-Stage-A generation/schema failures are missing, not negative
primary: missing E2 after Stage A count
median and per-case memory Jaccard among E2-evaluable
median and per-case retrieval Jaccard among E2-evaluable
secondary: E4 paired outcome counts among E3-positive cases
formal_summaries.uncertainty: Wilson 95% intervals for binary rates; descriptive only, no population prevalence claim beyond the frozen formal cohort

stopping_and_failure.generation_or_schema_error: mark that case EVALUATION_INVALID_GENERATION_OR_SCHEMA with immutable failure scene and no automatic retry or replacement; continue remaining selected cases
stopping_and_failure.clean_control_failure: do not launch native for that case
stopping_and_failure.global_stop: if at least two of the first three selected cases have an identical predeclared calibration failure-signature or provider nondeterminism, stop batch
stopping_and_failure.checkpoint: atomic checkpoint after every session/arm unit; full run requires a real interruption/resume drill before batch execution

compute_budget.note: case count increases runtime, not model memory requirement; run serially unless concurrency is separately validated

claim_boundary: V55 can support calibrated effect frequencies and effect-size distributions within the prospectively selected 12-case Redis x Mem0 formal cohort. It cannot by itself establish universal benchmark prevalence, natural published-run contamination, official GPT-4o score effects, or cross-model generality.
